name: PreviewDeepScan
read_consistency: one LLD-01 read snapshot over Source Scope/folder config and current coverage; optional resource estimate comes from bounded read-only source metadata probe and never inspects/persists message content
ordering: folder scope by role INBOX,SENT,OTHER then display_name/source_folder_id
rules: preview fingerprint binds scope revision/folders/bounds/current coverage and is consumed by StartDeepScan
preview itself never opens a background scan or advances coverage
